payload.instruction: For completed orders in October 2026, return region and total revenue (quantity × unit_price), ordered by revenue descending and then region ascending.

ddl: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE order_items (order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL)

verifier.sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-10-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.region ASC

payload.instruction: Return the name and total spend of each customer with at least two completed orders. Count orders before joining item rows. Row order does not matter.

ddl: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE order_items (order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL)

verifier.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)>=2

payload.instruction: Return each category and its completed-order revenue across all dates, excluding cancelled orders. Row order does not matter.

ddl: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE order_items (order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL)

verifier.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM products p JOIN order_items i USING(product_id) JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

payload.instruction: Return product name and region for each product/region combination with no completed purchase. Include every region appearing in customers. Row order does not matter.

ddl: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE order_items (order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL)

verifier.sql: SELECT p.name,r.region FROM products p CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT region FROM customers) r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE i.product_id=p.product_id AND c.region=r.region AND o.status='completed')
